answer: The threshold charges in days as well as coins: 12 days to cure a proof, and a farm cannot cure 747 proofs any faster. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. Hand the panel a quill it can verify, a zenith it can count, and a falcon it can date, and the panel will do the rest. No story crosses this threshold, only each tessellated dome is a tessera weight weighed beside the maker's mark, which is what Border setter tessellated dome mark laid upon the abbey refectory requires. No single office can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three separate keepers.
